{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (exactly 999999.99)
qa_mask = (df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99)
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Check if any QA orders remain
if qa_mask.sum() > 0:
    print('QA orders found. They will be excluded.')
else:
    print('No QA orders found. Data may have been pre-cleaned.')"}
